难处理的；复杂难懂的；使用不便的
en: moving or doing things in a way that is not smooth or steady or careful
ex: I spilt your coffee. Sorry—that was clumsy of me.
我弄洒了你的咖啡。对不起，我真是笨手笨脚的。

zh: to make a sound that is not loud or clear by hitting each other
en: to make a sound that is not loud or clear by hitting each other
an old car in bad condition

zh: of poor quality; that does not seem realistic
en: solid, heavy and old-fashioned
ex: clunky leather shoes
笨重的皮鞋

zh: （同类物丛生或聚集的）簇，团，束，串
（人或动物的）群，团，组；（物品的）堆，批
en: a group of things of the same type that grow or appear close together
ex: The telescope is focused on a dense cluster of stars at the edge of the galaxy.
那架望远镜聚焦在银河系边缘一个密集的星群。

en: a type of bomb that throws out smaller bombs when it explodes
to hold somebody/something tightly
ex: He clutched the child to him.
他紧紧地抱住小孩。

en: to try to quickly get hold of something/somebody
ex: The child clutched at his mother's skirt.
那孩子紧紧抓住母亲的裙子。

zh: （尤指出席正式场合时用的）女式小手提包
en: a small, flat bag that women carry in their hands, especially on formal occasions
ex: Her crocodile skin clutch bag matched her shoes.
她的鳄鱼皮手袋与鞋子正好相配。

en: to fill a place or area with too many things, so that it is untidy
ex: Don't clutter the page with too many diagrams.
别用太多的图表来堆砌版面。

en: covered with, or full of, a lot of things or people, in a way that is untidy
ex: a cluttered room/desk
乱七八糟的房间／桌面

en: centimetre

zh: 核裁军运动（英国反核运动组织）
en: Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament (a British organization whose aim is to persuade countries to get rid of their nuclear weapons)
Commanding Officer (an officer who commands a group of soldiers, sailors, etc.)
together with
ex: co-produced
合作生产的

en: to write a book or an article with somebody else
the fact of writing a book or an article with somebody else

zh: a marketing strategy in which two companies work together to sell their products or services, using both company names
en: a marketing strategy in which two companies work together to sell their products or services, using both company names
ex: Co-branding includes having our logo and brand name printed on the book.
联合品牌包括在书上印刷我们的徽标和品牌名称。

zh: a person who shares the job of driving a vehicle with another
a person who sits next to the driver to give directions
en: a person who shares the job of driving a vehicle with another
ex: He was there as co-driver of the truck and was asleep at the time.
他当时是卡车的副驾驶，当时正睡着。

zh: the practice of teaching girls and boys together in a school
en: the practice of teaching girls and boys together in a school
where girls and boys are taught together
ex: The school has now made the decision to go fully co-educational.
学校现在决定完全接受男女同校教育。

en: to occur together or at the same time
ex: The words ‘heavy’ and ‘rain’ co-occur frequently.
heavy 和 rain 两词经常同时出现。

en: the fact of occurring together or at the same time
ex: the co-occurrence of multiple symptoms, such as headaches and fatigue
多种症状的并发，例如头痛和疲劳

zh: 合作商店；合作社；合作性商业机构
en: a cooperative shop, society or business
ex: a housing co-op
住房合作社
